mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, enabled, morning_at, noon_at, evening_at, bedtime_at, follow_up_min, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE people_medication_reminder SET enabled = #{enabled}, morning_at = #{morningAt}, noon_at = #{noonAt}, evening_at = #{eveningAt}, bedtime_at = #{bedtimeAt}, follow_up_min = #{followUpMin}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.people_id FROM people_medication m INNER JOIN account_patient ap ON ap.people_id = m.people_id AND ap.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND ap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
